Implement `toggleExclusiveSection(state, name)`. `state` must be a plain object whose own enumerable values are booleans, and `name` must be one of its own keys. Return a new plain object with the same key order. If the named section was closed, open it and close every other section. If it was open, close every section. An empty state is valid but no name can be selected from it. Throw `TypeError` for malformed arguments and `RangeError` for an unknown name. Do not mutate or return the input object. Export exactly the function with `module.exports = toggleExclusiveSection`.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
